The report summarizes confirmed and intermittent items and gives a diagnosis: power OK, but the air conditioning needs repair and the rear window motor may be aging. Clear fault points like these can be used directly to negotiate a lower price or demand refurbishment.
map.电池电压和充电电压多少算正常？: What Battery and Charging Voltages Are Normal?
map.熄火静置电池电压约 12.2~12.8V 为正常，低于 12.0V 可能亏电或老: With the engine off, a resting battery voltage of about 12.2–12.8 V is normal; below 12.0 V the battery may be discharged or aging. With the engine running, a charging voltage of about 13.8–14.6 V indicates normal alternator output. Abnormal values in either usually point to battery or alternator problems. Follow the thresholds in the vehicle manual.
map.间歇性故障为什么单列？: Why Are Intermittent Faults Listed Separately?
map.间歇性（偶发）故障难以复现、修复成本高且易被掩盖，工具将其与「确认故障」分开统计: Intermittent faults are hard to reproduce, expensive to fix, and easy to hide, so the tool counts them separately from "confirmed faults" to remind buyers to budget for repair uncertainty; confirmed faults can be priced straight into a deduction.
